versions.content: The service SoAd_ReadDhcpHostNameOption () shall forward the call to TcpIp_DhcpV6ReadOption () with the parameter Option set to the option code 39 according to IETF RF C 4704, if the socket connection identified by SoConId is related to a local address of the TcpIp_DomainType TCPIP_AF_INET6 .
